verdict.rationale: Sharing availability or inserting bookable times into an email is a fair question for an email-and-calendar client like Outlook, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents this capability. The closest items are adjacent: Graph APIs that get or update a user's working hours, and MailTips that show recipients' out-of-office status. Neither inserts availability or bookable slots into a message.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
